description: Reusable authored-pose direction for ninja player identities. Registry metadata and the staged portrait control identity; this profile supplies stealth weapon choreography.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: silent, low, abrupt, agile, and economical, with precise foot placement, concealed preparation, and crisp attack recovery
identity.equipmentRule: Preserve the portrait's mask, dark cloth layers, wraps, pouches, kunai, shuriken, blades, and exact item count. Move only one established weapon into action at a time; never duplicate, swap hands, unmask, or invent gear.
identity.magicRule: Ninja techniques are physical stealth. Do not add shadow clones, teleportation, aura, runes, or elemental magic; a tiny dust puff or short weapon glint may support real movement.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} preserving Image 1's covered face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, mask, cloth layers, wraps, pouches, weapons, palette, and proportions. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into a compact stealth-ready silhouette. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery and a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment ramps. One centered ninja in a low alert crouch facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall ninja motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve exact identity, mask, cloth, wraps, palette, proportions, pouches, and weapon count. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: A low silent loop alternates controlled breath, shoulder checks, and minute hand shifts near established weapons.
idle.effectRule: No smoke or attack effect; cloth tails and wraps settle minimally.

walk.motionDirection: A low forefoot walk uses alternating contacts, deep knee compression, quiet passing poses, close arm motion, and controlled cloth follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No smoke, clone, or magic; one tiny grounded dust accent may appear at a planted step.

attack.motionDirection: A concealed hand draw becomes a low lateral step, fast close-range slash, compact reverse follow-through, and immediate re-concealment.
attack.effectRule: Show exactly one established handheld weapon and one short physical swish at contact; no duplicate weapon, clone, or projectile.

one hand reaches for exactly one established weapon
weapon clears its holder during a deep lateral coil

hurt.motionDirection: A sudden hit exposes the crouch into a sharp twist, tumbling step, three-point catch, guarded rise, and renewed concealment.
hurt.effectRule: One compact physical impact accent only; no gore, blood, smoke disappearance, unmasking, or dropped weapons.

sharp torso twist with forearms guarding

forced tumbling step backward

recovered concealed crouch

death.motionDirection: A final hit breaks the crouch, legs fail, the ninja catches low, rolls into a side collapse, and settles fully fallen with mask and gear intact.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, smoke disappearance, clone, or rigid rotation; keep mask and equipment recognizable.

arms spread as balance fails

body reaches full ground contact

victory.motionDirection: The ninja confirms victory, rises from concealment, performs a tight weapon flourish, returns the weapon to its holder, gives a restrained hand sign, and holds.
victory.effectRule: One established weapon may catch a tiny glint; no smoke, clone, aura, or added weapon.
